review: RFC 9114 requirements inventory independent adversarial review
review_mode: static-only; no Gleam, Erlang, escript, or native process executed

scale.1: same feature area but no direct assertion of the normative behavior
scale.2: core condition is asserted, but actor/role, branch, ordering, or required wire result is missing
scale.3: cited test directly asserts actor, trigger, and required result; cited source contains the branch

scoring.closure_rule: Only score 3 supports Implemented. NotApplicable is judged by normative actor and shipped profile, not by absence of a feature alone.

critical_contradiction.normative_summary: If a client receives a previously promised push ID with mismatching decompressed fields, it MUST respond with H3_GENERAL_PROTOCOL_ERROR.
critical_contradiction.detail: InconsistentDuplicatePromise is mapped to 0x108 (H3_ID_ERROR), but this clause requires H3_GENERAL_PROTOCOL_ERROR (0x101).
critical_contradiction.required_assertion: Inject two PUSH_PROMISE frames with the same push ID and mismatching decompressed fields through the client protocol adapter; assert the connection closes with application error 0x101, never 0x108.
